metadata.status_reason: harvardilj.org no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN); canonical site is journals.law.harvard.edu/ilj/, a WordPress Multisite subsite. Re-onboarded 2026-08-28 onto HarvardJournalsMultisiteAdapter: the shared WordPressAcademicBaseAdapter rooted REST/sitemap at the bare origin, where the network root site has zero posts, so this seed produced no PDFs. Titles on issue-hub-derived PDFs fall back to the issue page title (known WP adapter limitation).
metadata.status_evidence_ref: smoke 2026-08-28: 6 archive pages -> 105 direct issue PDFs + 238 issue/article post links, all under /ilj/; PDF GET 200 application/pdf

publication_scope.notes: Multisite host carries many Harvard journals. Discovery, page traversal and PDF acceptance are all gated on the /ilj/ path prefix, including PDFs under /ilj/wp-content/uploads/sites/84/.

navigation.pagination: /category/archives/page/N/ (6 pages as of 2026-08-28; enumerated explicitly in start_urls)
navigation.notes: HTML-first discovery is deliberate: the journal's own Jetpack sitemap (/ilj/sitemap.xml) and REST API (/ilj/wp-json/wp/v2/posts, 1304 posts) enumerate the whole subsite, which mixes in HILJ Online (separately seeded as registry_harvard_international_law_journal_online_1422_*.json) and blog posts whose bodies link third-party citation PDFs (archive.org etc.). robots.txt allows these paths, Crawl-delay: 10.

selectors.selector: article a[href*='volume-'], article a[href*='issue_'], article a[href*='issue-']
